info.name: FieldForceConnect API Tests
info.description:
API test collection for https://test.fieldforceconnect.com/

Covers:
  1. POST Login — valid credentials (captures auth token)
  2. POST Login — invalid credentials (asserts error)
  3. GET authenticated endpoint (uses {{token}})
  4. POST Add Customer (uses {{token}})

IMPORTANT: Before running, update the environment variables:
  - valid_email / valid_password: your test account credentials
  - base_url: should already be set to https://test.fieldforceconnect.com

The token variable is set automatically by the Login test script:
  pm.environment.set('token', ...)

⚠️  REAL API ENDPOINTS:
  The exact endpoint paths below (e.g. /api/auth/login) are educated guesses
  based on common REST API patterns. To find the real paths:
    1. Open Chrome DevTools → Network tab → filter by Fetch/XHR
    2. Perform Login and Add Customer on the live site
    3. Note the Request URL from each XHR call
    4. Update the 'url' fields in each request below

Schema: https://schema.getpostman.com/json/collection/v2.1.0/collection.json
